title: Let It Burn Pottery Mobile Raku Experience
source_quote: Are you looking to add some excitement to your next get together or special event? Why not try our mobile raku experience. The ONLY mobile pottery firing experience in SWFL. Take home your pottery piece the same evening!
evidence_sentence: The homepage describes a mobile raku firing service where customers bring glazed pieces and take them home fired the same evening.
evidence_quote: Raku is a firing process where we bring glazed pieces to around 1900 degrees and pull them out of the kiln.
summary: Let It Burn Pottery offers a mobile raku firing service for events in southwest Florida where you bring glazed pottery and take it home the same day.
how_to_join: Contact the studio or book through the Bookings link to host an event.
